text:
Peacefully flows the Quiet Don;

to my house seeps the yellow moon.

It hops over the windowsill with its cap askew

and stops in the shadow, that yellow moon.

This woman is sick to the marrow,

this woman is completely alone,

with her husband dead, and her son distant

in prison. Pray for me. Pray.

translation.title: Peacefully Flows the Quiet Don
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the moon's strange entrance and the plain plea from isolation.
